message:
I made a modified version of Yvette to go alongside the Warhammer Fantasy Game Master and the Combat Referee.
Here is the character of Yvette, known as Yvette Whippoorwill:
https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=Yvette_Whippoorwill~bd1323dacf26fc93601f0905b8409ba0.gz

Reminder: You WILL start in Marienburg, and that is where the beginning of the session and RP will go. I tried to keep the spirit of Yvette as in-tact as I could. Her class is Rogue, and her career is "Outlaw" but she's not a wanted criminal - she's just a random woman who just arrived in Marienburg's docks on a skiff one day.
Lean into the culture shock, and have fun with her adjusting to The Old World!

Plus... no offense to the Original author, but his world of Relvon and Jade are so mundane and boring with how much of a medieval dystopia it is. It'd be one thing if there actually was an existential threat to the world and setting, but they're isn't.
But that's okay, because it fosters this atmosphere of a spiritually dead world that somehow reminds me of the Empire of Sadera from GATE and how that faction's way of life set them up for failure because they couldn't conceive of other solutions when faced with an enemy that beat them at their own game.

And funny enough, I think that might be the point, but I'm not sure. As firm of a believer I am of "Death of the Author", I don't believe it'd be much wiser for me to not assume what the author was thinking, nor take joy in using his work as a punching bag (even though it would be really funny to do so).

Anyways, my tangent is over. Enjoy!
